description: Installation of an internally illuminated LED free standing advertisement display.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The display of the advertisement hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 6 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity
Condition : 7 - The proposed signage shall not have any intermittent light source, moving feature, animation or exposed cold cathode tubing.

Condition : 8 - The intensity of the illumination of the sign shall not exceed 300 cd/m2 at any time and shall be below the limit set out in the Institute of Lighting Engineers (ILE) technical note number 5 "The brightness of illuminated advertisement".

Condition : 9 - The sign(s) shall be fitted with a light intensity monitoring censor to ensure the illuminance intensity is dimmable to take account of ambient light conditions and comply with the maximum recommended lighting intensity.

Condition : 10 - The footway / cycleway and the carriageway of A4 Great West Road shall not be blocked during the installation and maintenance of the signage. Temporary obstructions during the installation shall be kept to a minimum and shall not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians / cyclists or obstruct the flow of traffic on A4 Great West Road.
Condition : 11 - All vehicles associated with the installation and maintenance shall only park / stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
Condition : 12 - No skips or installation / construction materials shall be kept on the footway / cycleway or carriageway on the TLRN at any time.
